'''Geedo Loken and the Lo-keys''' was the name of the [[Music/Legends|music]] [[Band/Legends|band]] acting in the [[Cabana Bar]] of [[Rorkee]] ([[Genarius]]) in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. They played dancing music, although they commonly did not know the songs that the audience asked them to play.
